children: Maruti Suzuki India Limited (NSE:MARUTI) posted record volumes and strong domestic demand but Q2 profit fell ~26% as margins tighten; the company ramps EV capacity and exports from Hansalpur, launched Wagon R Flex Fuel, cites logistics headwinds and a 265,000 vehicle order book.
Previous Week Recap
Maruti Q2 Volumes, Revenue, Profit
: Maruti Suzuki (MARUTI) hit record volumes: Oct sales 276,120 (+25% YoY), Q2 sales 696,654 (+26.5% YoY), H1 volumes 1,379,378. Q2 revenue ~Rs53,340–53,356cr; Q2 net profit ~Rs2,466cr (‑26% YoY).
Hansalpur Plant Global EV Hub
: Maruti Suzuki's Hansalpur plant is Suzuki’s sole global maker of the e Vitara, raised annual EV capacity to 1M units, and handled ~50% of Maruti’s overseas EV exports in FY2025-26 to ~120 markets.
West Asia Export Disruptions
: Maruti Suzuki (MARUTI) reports escalating West Asia shipping disruptions and strained alternate export routes, complicating logistics and export delivery as the company seeks new channels.
Wagon R Flex Fuel Launch
: Maruti Suzuki (MARUTI) launched the Wagon R Flex Fuel in June 2026, able to run on ethanol‑petrol blends E20–E100; launch follows new government approvals allowing higher ethanol blends.
Analyst Targets And Margins
: Maruti Suzuki (MARUTI) analyst targets: Rs 14,800, 14,537, 14,500, 13,500, 13,300, 13,046. Brokers note near-term margin pressure; potential relief from higher volumes and easing commodity costs.
Domestic Demand Strong; Price Hikes
: Maruti Suzuki (MARUTI) says domestic demand stays strong despite macro and geopolitical headwinds. Company may apply calibrated price hikes in H2 to offset rising raw material costs, per chairman.
Dzire Production Milestone; 5-Star NCAP
: Maruti Suzuki (MARUTI): Dzire hit 3.5 million cumulative production at Manesar after ~18 years 9 months. Company highlights Dzire’s 5-star Bharat NCAP rating; CEO cited focus on quality and growth.
Rural Demand Risk; Festive Visibility
: Maruti Suzuki (MARUTI) warns poor monsoon and El Niño could hit rural demand but saw no impact in the festive season. Pending order book ~265,000 vehicles, giving near-term demand visibility.
Shares Up 2% On Results Day
: On its results day, shares of Maruti Suzuki India Limited (MARUTI) closed about 2% higher at ₹11,450, while the stock remains down approximately 32% year-to-date.
